title: Teen Boy Kills FSU Student in Brutal Hit and Run
description:
Tallahassee police respond after FSU student Elizabeth Sims is struck and killed in a hit-and-run at a crosswalk. Officers piece together witness accounts to track down 18-year-old Willis Trueblood Jr., who later speaks with detectives about what happened that night.
